text:
maria: thinking we should simplify sidecar handshake for Private. propose a 'lite' mode: only auth, probe, version — removes manifest complexity.
aj: what about secrets / KMS access? Private still needs to fetch keys for model artifacts.
maria: agree — lite mode won't fetch secrets. it will assert a key-handle and delegate decryption to the control plane. avoids HSM in sidecar.
tom: we also need eviction detection. plan: heartbeat probe + an /eviction_reason codepoint. on eviction -> emit metric + graceful fallback.
lina: fallback to Hosted is risky for regulated customers. can't auto-fallback without consent/config. data residency + compliance matters.
aj: propose fallback policy enum: deny | cached-only | redirect-hosted. default = deny for safety. orgs can opt-in to redirect-hosted.
kyle: rollout idea: feature-flag per org, canary to 5 orgs first. track metrics: sidecar.handshake.latency, eviction.count, fallback.invocations, fallback.latency.
maria: sketch of handshake proto: ```json
{"mode":"lite","version":"1","auth":"token-hash","probe_interval_ms":5000}
```
tom: add a serving_hint header from client => routing hint: low_latency | cost_saver | compliant. helps make fallback decisions without heavy negotiation.
lina: serving_hint might expose intent; ensure ACL mapping and require customer consent for cross-hosted fallback. also audit logs.
infra-bot: eviction-detector v0.3 deployed to staging — test hooks active :rocket: 
aj: telemetry: include correlation_id that flows sidecar->runtime->controlplane. sample traces at 10% and capture full events on eviction.
maria: next steps: write RFC with handshake proto, policy enums, migration guide, and rollout plan. volunteers to draft: maria, aj, tom. schedule 30m sync next Tue.
kyle: :thumbsup: add rollback tests and a simulated eviction chaos test.
lina: :raised_hands: I'll review the security & residency sections.
maria: created RFC draft PR: https://git.internal/r/PR-438 — please comment. closing thread for now.
